name: Fluidstack
description: Fluidstack is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Fluidstack is a privately held AI infrastructure company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent reported financing, a $1.5 billion round led by Jane Street in September 2026, valued the company at $18 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in New York, Fluidstack builds and operates data centers and computing clusters for AI developers, including Anthropic. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Fluidstack
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. Fluidstack announced in July 2026 that it had raised the Series A in January; it has not announced the September 2026 round, whose figures are as reported by Forbes.
round_notes: Fluidstack declined to comment on the Forbes report; a Form D that the company filed with the SEC in June 2026 describes a $1.5 billion equity offering. In October 2026, Bloomberg reported that Situational Awareness was inviting its clients to invest alongside it in a new round that would value Fluidstack at $40 billion. Fluidstack has not announced a further round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Jane Street led the September 2026 round, according to Forbes, and Situational Awareness led the Series A. Other investors include BlackRock and Atreides Management.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, five special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Fluidstack have filed with the SEC, three of them in 2026.
funds: An SEC-registered fund managed by BlackRock reported a position in Fluidstack Series A preferred stock, which it valued at $6.2 million as of June 30, 2026.
sources: Sources: Fluidstack's announcements of its Series A and its move to New York; Anthropic's November 2025 announcement; reports by Forbes (September 2026) and Bloomberg (October 2026); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
